final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), pr AS (SELECT g.fundflux, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM pr) SELECT pr.fundflux, pr.cnt, pr.ratio, CAST(pr.cnt AS REAL) / a.avgcnt AS ratio_avg FROM pr JOIN a ON a.avgcnt IS NOT NULL
